description: Security and freshness check for one package version across npm, PyPI, Go, Maven, Cargo and NuGet: known vulnerabilities from OSV with CVE aliases, CVSS score and level, fixed versions and advisory URL; latest version, versions behind, publish date, licenses, deprecation flag and repository links from deps.dev; and a one-word verdict (ok, outdated or vulnerable). Version defaults to the latest release. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402).

ecosystem.description: npm (default), pypi, go, maven, cargo or nuget

name.description: Package name, e.g. lodash, @types/node, requests, github.com/gin-gonic/gin, org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-core

name: deps_check
title: deps_check
